content.text:
CI should pass now. `npm test` passes locally: 2 of 2 tests. I couldn't run CI itself, since this folder isn't a git repo.

I changed only `test/upload.test.js`. The upload test now starts a small stub HTTP server on a random free port on `127.0.0.1`. It passes that server's URL to `upload()`, which already took a `url` argument, so `upload.js` is untouched.

The test also checks that the request went to `POST /upload?name=a.txt` with the body `hello`. It shuts the server down afterward, even if an assertion fails.

An earlier attempt to write the file through a shell heredoc was denied, so I used the Write tool instead.
